{{Quote|I have infinite patience, sir, being a droid. However, I am constrained to point out that your current actions would seem to be in violation of the Imperial Legal Code, Section Fourteen, Subsection Nine, Part C-dash-one, which forbids tampering with autonomous droid function without official permission.|[[P-RC3]]|<ref name="DS" />}}
The '''Imperial Penal Code''', also known as the '''Imperial Legal Code''' and simply '''Imperial Code''', was a body of laws issued by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It represented the branch of Imperial legal statutes concerned with criminal law. It consisted of seventeen volumes.

Documented extracts include:
*[[Imperial Legal Code, Section Fourteen, Subsection Nine, Part C-dash-one]], and [[Section 2127]], which laid out the requirements for legal assassinations.<ref name="DS" />

One particular model of the [[groomer]] (an advanced model of the older [[XP-21 groomer|XP-21]]) contained all seventeen volumes of the code.

Infractions of the code had five different classifications based on the level of violation: [[Class Five infraction/Legends|Class Five]], [[Class Four infraction/Legends|Class Four]], [[Class Three infraction/Legends|Class Three]], [[Class Two infraction/Legends|Class Two]] and [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One]] infractions, with Class Five and One being the less and most severe offense respectively.

The Imperial Code was enforced separately and parallel to local [[Star_system/Legends|systemic]] laws. For example, while [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] some restricted [[spice/Legends|spice]] would be fined with a small fee according to the Imperial Code, the same violation was punishable by [[execution/Legends|execution]] in some particular systems.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
It is unclear whether the [[Imperial Military Code]] was included within this body of law as a subsection (eg, ''Section 14''), or whether it was an independent statute, with the Imperial Legal Code representing the wider law, not limited to the military, but applicable to the galactic community of Imperial citizens.
